title: The storage step in Hebrew
changes: Choosing where a story's materials live now reads in Hebrew: the question itself, the three ways to connect, resuming a folder you used before, restoring an exported story, and clearing what the browser remembers.

Untranslated English no longer looks broken on a Hebrew page. A screen still waiting for translation used to have its question marks and full stops thrown to the far left; each paragraph now takes its own direction from its own words.
Fixed the English that sentence had always had: "Where does this story's materials live" is now "Where do".
